description: Estimates the USD cost of a call from the price list (with a credential your account's view: its tier and grants; public otherwise): an estimate, not an invoice (the bill uses provider-reported usage and any custom pricing on your account). Pass only the usage fields the model's billing_type (see get_model or get_pricing) reads: per_token: input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_input_tokens; per_image: image_count, resolution_tier; per_second_video: duration_seconds, quality_mode, sound; per_second_audio: duration_seconds; per_character: character_count; per_media_token: media_input_tokens, media_output_tokens. Add store_output / retention / file_count for storage fees.

usage.description: What the call uses; only the fields of the model's billing type matter.

cache_write_1h_input_tokens.description: per_token: 1-hour prompt-cache writes (a subset of input_tokens).

cache_write_5m_input_tokens.description: per_token: 5-minute prompt-cache writes (a subset of input_tokens).

cached_input_tokens.description: per_token: cached-read tokens (a subset of input_tokens).

character_count.description: per_character: characters of text to speak.

duration_seconds.description: per_second_video / per_second_audio: seconds of output; for an edit of an input video (Kling Omni/o1 base_video_url, Motion Control) pass the input video's length, which is what is rendered and billed. Speech-to-text: seconds of input audio.

file_count.description: Files the storage fee applies to (default image_count, else 1).

has_ref.description: per_second_video: a reference input is present (Kling O1).

mode.description: mode: direct (Relay's providers, the default) or opengpu (the decentralized network, priced separately).

resolution_tier.description: per_image / per_second_video: resolution key of the row, e.g. 1K, 2K, 720p.

retention.description: Upload retention SKU from get_pricing media_storage; relay1h is free.

store_output.description: Output storage SKU from get_pricing media_storage (adds its per-file fee); provider is free.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate a Relay cost
